tours.name: Export the Bank Payment File for Salaries

name_i18n.en_US: Export the Bank Payment File for Salaries

tours.description: Learn how to prepare the bank payment file for the salaries: open the bank data report, select the payslips to pay, and export the Paymaster file that is sent to the bank.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to prepare the bank payment file for the salaries: open the bank data report, select the payslips to pay, and export the Paymaster file that is sent to the bank.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: The bank payment file is produced from the Reporting menu of the Payroll app once the payslips are confirmed.

description_i18n.en_US: The bank payment file is produced from the Reporting menu of the Payroll app once the payslips are confirmed.

steps.title: Reporting menu
steps.description: The Reporting menu holds the payroll reports, including the schedules for the tax and pension authorities and the bank data.

description_i18n.en_US: The Reporting menu holds the payroll reports, including the schedules for the tax and pension authorities and the bank data.

steps.title: Bank Data
steps.description: This list shows, for each payslip, the information the bank needs: the employee bank account, the branch, the net amount and the originating account.

description_i18n.en_US: This list shows, for each payslip, the information the bank needs: the employee bank account, the branch, the net amount and the originating account.

steps.title: Select the payslips
steps.content: Tick the box in the header to select all payslips.

content_i18n.en_US: Tick the box in the header to select all payslips.

steps.description: Select the payslips that should be paid in this transfer. Ticking the header box selects every payslip in the list; use the search bar first to keep only one pay period or batch.

description_i18n.en_US: Select the payslips that should be paid in this transfer. Ticking the header box selects every payslip in the list; use the search bar first to keep only one pay period or batch.

steps.title: Actions menu
steps.description: Once payslips are selected, the Actions menu offers what you can do with them.

description_i18n.en_US: Once payslips are selected, the Actions menu offers what you can do with them.

steps.title: Export Paymaster file
steps.description: This creates the Paymaster file from the selected payslips and downloads it. Upload it to your bank portal to pay the salaries, then mark the batch as paid in Odoo.

description_i18n.en_US: This creates the Paymaster file from the selected payslips and downloads it. Upload it to your bank portal to pay the salaries, then mark the batch as paid in Odoo.
